What We Offer

Comprehensive psychiatric care

From diagnosis and medication management to specialized therapy and integrative wellness — we provide the full spectrum of psychiatric support.

01

Psychiatric Evaluation & Diagnosis

Comprehensive mental health assessments with diagnostic clarification for mood, anxiety, and behavioral disorders. Second opinions on existing diagnoses available.

  • Comprehensive mental health assessments
  • Diagnostic clarification for mood, anxiety, and behavioral disorders
  • Second opinions on existing diagnoses
02

Medication Management

Evidence-based prescribing with ongoing monitoring, dosage adjustments based on patient response, and thorough education on medication benefits and risks.

  • Prescription and monitoring of psychiatric medications
  • Adjustments based on patient response and side effects
  • Education on medication benefits and risks
03

Specialized Disorder Treatment

Targeted treatment for a wide range of psychiatric conditions — depression, anxiety, ADHD, OCD, bipolar disorder, ASD, substance use, and psychosis.

  • Depression and anxiety treatment
  • ADHD evaluation and management
  • Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) therapy
  • Bipolar disorder and mood disorder stabilization
  • Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) support
  • Mild substance use and addiction treatment
  • Psychosis and schizophrenia treatment
04

Psychotherapy (Talk Therapy)

Individual counseling, CBT, psychodynamic therapy, and trauma-focused approaches including EMDR and exposure therapy for PTSD.

  • Individual therapy: one-on-one counseling
  • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
  • Psychodynamic therapy
  • Trauma therapy: PTSD treatment with EMDR and exposure therapy
05

Lifestyle & Integrative Psychiatry

A holistic approach that addresses sleep, stress, nutrition, and mindfulness — targeting the biological roots of mental health alongside the psychological.

  • Sleep and stress management strategies
  • Nutritional psychiatry for mental well-being
  • Mindfulness and holistic approaches
06

Perinatal Psychiatry

Specialized support for mood disorders during pregnancy, postpartum recovery, infertility, and parent-infant bonding — with pregnancy-safe medication options.

  • Diagnosis & treatment of perinatal mood disorders
  • Medication management including pregnancy-safe options
  • Support for pregnancy loss & infertility
  • Parent-infant bonding support
07

Women's Mental Health

Comprehensive care for hormonal mood disorders, trauma, chronic illness, and life-stage transitions — from PMDD and menopause to postpartum and beyond.

  • Hormonal mood disorders (PMDD, menopause-related depression/anxiety)
  • Trauma & PTSD treatment (birth trauma, sexual trauma)
  • Anxiety & depression across the lifespan
  • Support for women with chronic illness
  • Relationship & parenting counseling
